findings.description: Retention cost omits KimiPart.fileId, variable array element storage including message.content, and Payload.sourceEnds. These are retained field/storage classes, not the disclosed dictionary buckets or an RSS-estimate error.
evidence: Public hits(): 8 MiB fileId retained with byteBudget=256, estimatedByteCount=157, entryCount=2, search instance released.
Public hits(): 65,536 empty-type decoded parts retain 12,058,624 bytes of part elements with byteBudget=256, estimatedByteCount=126, search instance released.
Synthetic public store(): Array<Int> sourceEnds retains 8 MiB with byteBudget=64, estimatedByteCount=20. This last probe is not presented as an ordinary product-built payload.
findings.suggested_fix: Include fileId UTF-8 and variable message/part/source/offset/hit element storage in both retained-cost walks, preserving disclosed conservative double counts and separately disclosed dictionary-bucket exclusion. Independently pin each newly covered class with small-budget refusal fixtures, not a call to the same estimatedCost function under test.

findings.description: The disclosed single query allocation / CoW-sharing premise is false after turn-boundary reuse. Verified previous entries keep previous.query; new node.query uses the current independently decoded query, and payload conversion preserves entry.query. Multiple equal-byte query allocations remain in one shared prefix node but only node.query is charged.
evidence: Public hits(), eight turn advances with separately decoded equal 1 MiB queries and budget-0 lower tiers, then release the search instance: final prefix node has eight distinct retained query buffers (seven payload buffers, none sharing node.query), 8,388,608 query UTF-8 bytes, entryCount=14.
byteBudget=3,145,728; estimatedByteCount=2,098,135; only 1,048,576 node-query bytes charged, besides key bytes.
findings.suggested_fix: Charge every payload query conservatively, or enforce rebinding to the current node query during payload construction before relying on shared-storage accounting. Pin independent decoding and successive turn advances with a constrained budget, and correct the sharing documentation.

findings.description: The non-vacuity assertion proves a node is in the table, not that hits() consumes it. The equality-only d2 assertion also cannot require conversion/reuse rather than lower-tier fallback.
evidence: bypass-shared-hit: make the hits() shared-node else-if condition permanently false; complete release WorkbenchChecks still exits 0 with 108 PASS.
drop-converted-entry: make Entries.shared.entry always return nil; complete release WorkbenchChecks still exits 0 with 108 PASS.
Unmutated d2 is not vacuous: scoped instrumentation observed six successful shared payload conversions and reuse of all six, including activity:tool:w1.
findings.suggested_fix: Add branch-consumption mechanism pins using a seeded sentinel node and seeded sentinel entry payload, with budget-0 lower tiers; require the sentinel to emerge from hits() and from a within-instance boundary advance. Preserve the independent four-regime byte oracle. mechanism-pin-proposal.swift demonstrates both positive pins on the candidate; proposed fixes still require their own mutation red runs.

other_review_results.purity_and_adoption: The window predicate, previous/held lookup order and stored-messages to adopted.messages refresh preserve the faithful-prefix-lift behavior. Materialized Array(prefix) prevents suffix backing-storage retention. No additional new result/staleness defect established.
other_review_results.locale: Observer clears table and accounting and advances generation; generation captured before prefix rebuilding and checked at store. In-flight lookups can return their old immutable snapshot but do not reinsert invalidated nodes. Existing instance-level earlier/entry locale behavior is inherited, not newly claimed to be generation-checked.
other_review_results.thread_safety: Single table lock, outside-lock immutable snapshot validation, benign duplicate builds and single-copy replacement accounting. Two-pass lastUse can be reordered or stamp a same-key replacement; effect is approximate eviction recency, not result corruption or budget-accounting leakage. Product-built NSString is immutable; public externally mutable payloads are outside this assumption. No Thread Sanitizer run performed.
other_review_results.bench: Fresh rendered, entry and prefix caches isolate cold iterations and the same-instance query-update pass. Timed query updates follow five warm-up updates. Reopen uses default shared tiers and is warmed outside timing. Comments match implementation.
other_review_results.existing_tests: ConversationEntryCacheTests helper only adds the third tier to budget-0/fresh injection; no preexisting assertion weakened. ProtocolTests adds one registration.
other_review_results.ab_evidence: All v1/v2 raw metric samples (4,440 values) and the extra edit batch (240 values), plus all summary numeric fields, agree with supplied summaries. Mac v2 89 metrics positives=NONE under the documented rounded classifier; Mac base/candidate checks 108/109 PASS; first/final binary hashes equal. Linux cold and edit-family disclosures do not independently block this Mac-target candidate.
